ticket.summary: Repeat customer's gas water heater pilot won't stay lit (started tonight, dies ~10 min after lighting) - no hot water, infant in home; no gas smell, no leak. Booked first priority slot for thermocouple service.

quote_lines.description: Water heater pilot/thermocouple service - flat rate; unit installed by us last year, check parts warranty on site

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Sam - booked for Tuesday, Sep 1 at 8:00 AM at 77 Birchwood Ln, first stop of the day. Tonight you can leave the heater as is; there's no leak or gas odor, so nothing needs shutting off. For the baby's bottles, warming water on the stove is your best bet until we're there. See you in the morning!
